title: Snake Game
description: Modern, responsive Snake game with multiple themes, level-based obstacle difficulty, persistent high scores, on-screen D-pad, swipe gestures, and haptic feedback.

title: Canvas Image Editor
description: Browser-based image editor with real-time filters, brightness/contrast/saturation adjustments, rotate/flip transformations, drag & drop upload, and high-resolution canvas export.

title: To-Do List Web App
description: Clean, minimal to-do list app to add, complete, and delete tasks, with task statistics and persistent storage using localStorage.

title: Personal Portfolio
description: Single-page developer portfolio featuring a canvas-based scrollytelling hero section, parallax overlays, glassmorphism UI, and a dynamic featured projects showcase.

title: MAC-OS (React Portfolio UI)
description: A macOS desktop-inspired UI built with React and SCSS — draggable/resizable windows, a top Nav bar with live clock, and a hover-animated Dock.
